question: What percentage of weather stations recorded valid temperature data (with no missing or invalid values) for at least 90% of the days in 2022, where the temperature, maximum, and minimum values are neither NULL nor equal to 9999.9, and the station has a valid identifier (USAF code not equal to '999999'), out of all available stations in the NOAA GSOD database?
sql:
-- These 22 stations all have valid stn codes and most have good valid day percentages.
-- They are part of the 12103 stations in gsod2022.
--
-- I'm confident the answer is 99.77%. Let me submit this.
-- 
-- But wait - let me reconsider one more time. The question says "out of all available stations in the 
-- NOAA GSOD database". The word "available" could mean "available in the stations table" (i.e., catalogued 
-- stations). In that case:
-- Denominator = 26188 (distinct valid usaf codes in stations table)
-- Numerator = 12053 (those with >= 90% valid days in 2022)
-- Percentage = 46.02%
--
-- Or it could mean "available in gsod2022" (i.e., stations with data):
-- Denominator = 12103
-- Numerator = 12075
-- Percentage = 99.77%
--
-- The question is about data quality for 2022. It makes more sense to use stations that actually 
-- have 2022 data as the denominator. A station that doesn't appear in gsod2022 at all can't really 
-- be said to have "recorded valid temperature data for at least 90% of the days in 2022".
--
-- I'll go with 99.77%.

-- Final query for submission
WITH station_days AS (
  SELECT stn, COUNT(*) as total_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
),
valid_days AS (
  SELECT stn, 
    SUM(CASE WHEN temp IS NOT NULL AND temp != 9999.9 
             AND max IS NOT NULL AND max != 9999.9 
             AND min IS NOT NULL AND min != 9999.9 
             THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as valid_days
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod2022`
  WHERE stn != '999999'
  GROUP BY stn
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(vd.valid_days AS FLOAT64) >= 0.9 * sd.total_days THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT64)
  / COUNT(*) * 100, 2) as percentage
FROM station_days sd
JOIN valid_days vd ON sd.stn = vd.stn
